script:
$env:Path += ";C:\Users\E\AppData\Local\hermes\bin"
"=== setting up custom provider ==="
hermes config set custom_providers.zen.type "openai" 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 2
hermes config set custom_providers.zen.base_url "https://opencode.ai/zen/v1" 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 2
hermes config set custom_providers.zen.api_key '${ZEN_API_KEY}' 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 2
hermes config set model "custom:zen/space-bunny-free" 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 2
"=== setting ZEN_API_KEY in .env ==="
$token = (Get-Content "C:\Users\E\AppData\Local\hermes\.env" -Raw | Select-String "OPENAI_API_KEY=(.*)").Matches.Groups[1].Value.Trim()
"ZEN_API_KEY=$token" | Out-File -FilePath "C:\Users\E\AppData\Local\hermes\.env" -Encoding utf8
"Done"
